steps.text: Cleanup Pass
Schedule
Run the first pass 90 s after launch
Run a pass every hour after that (`PASS_EVERY`)
the Mac sleeps through `Instant`s, so the hour also goes by the wall clock
Run a pass 5 s after the policy changes (`retention::nudge`)
If a recording runs
Try the pass again in 60 s
For Each Bundle in the Captures Folder
If the bundle is protected or busy
it is pinned, owed delivery, claimed, owed a `scrawl recover` build, or has a copy marker under a day old
Skip the bundle
If the bundle is under 10 minutes old or changed in the last 10 minutes
Skip the bundle
If the bundle is under a day old or changed in the last day
Plan a shrink when its iPhone video qualifies
Go to the next bundle
If the bundle is older than `bundleDays`
Plan to trash the whole bundle
Otherwise
If the bundle is older than `mediaDays`
Plan to trash the heavy media that exists
Otherwise
Plan a shrink when its iPhone video qualifies
Apply the Plan
Remove leftovers over 6 hours old (`sweep_leftovers`)
the leftovers are `.shrinking.mov` files and `.trash-staging`
Drop the shrink steps unless a day has passed since the last shrink pass
Run each step
Log the pass when it is the first or when it planned a step
